Question: What happens when I ignore my twin flame when we’re in separation but he’s accusing me of cheating when its the other way around?
Answer: This might be a projection of his own behavior on you. However, if you are not married or in a committed relationship - there is no “cheating”, both of you are free to date other people. You can only cheat on a contract, a vow, if there is no vow of fidelity, the term “cheating” does not even apply. If you are in separation - block him everywhere and let your connection shift to 5D interaction between Higher Selves. Do not get involved in any 3D drama till both of you are healed and have raised your vibration. Read about TF surrender - lots of good answers on this topic.

Question: Is it possible that if your twin flame has a habit of cheating, he’ll try to stay away from you due to having fear of hurting you?

They might mature and desire to settle down one day, but if you want children, you might start looking for a Soulmate to marry.

Question: If I don't think of my twin flame in separation, is that good?
Answer: This is neither good nor bad, but very unusual. Most TFs try very hard to stop thinking about the TF but do not succeed. Not thinking about them can make it easier for you. But do you have dreams about them or feel their presence occasionally? Or is it total energetic separation? I had some clients who separated from the TF in their 20s and stopped thinking about them, even forgot all about them, married a Soulmate and had kids, but reunited with the TF in their 40s and that’s when the Journey started. In a TF Regression session, we asked their Guides - why they had forgotten about the TF for 20 years, and the Guides said that they needed to fulfill their contract with their Soul Family and it was easier without telepathic contact or thoughts about the TF. The Guides blocked their memories and separated them energetically temporarily so they could fall in love with their Soulmate and raise their children. (kids are almost always platonic Soulmates with pre-birth contract) So I wonder if this might be your situation. Another possibility - this was not your true TF but a Catalyst (some authors call them false TFs) - a temporary connection for learning specific lessons or even spiritual awakening, but without a life-long contract or energetic entanglement.

Question: Why do I keep getting dreams about people from my past? I keep on getting dreams of my old schoolmates and teachers, but they haven't aged and act like in 9th grade too, but the dreams are set in the present.
Answer: Either these dreams are symbolic of the ‘school of life” and spiritual lessons you need to learn - or you have some ‘unfinished business” in the 9th grade, a trauma, or unrequited love, maybe you need to reconnect with somebody from your school, etc. You can do ‘Akashic Library” meditations on YouTube and when you get your book - ask it to show you an important event or connection that happened in the 9th grade that keeps taking you back in dreams. You might get an insight into why do you see these folks in your dreams. Another possibility - you might miss being a teenager, a carefree time in school, and feel that you are becoming too old now - and your never-aging classmates in dreams provide the contrast to your current adult life. But if you go to the class reunion in real life - you will see that they are also older, fatter, burdened by responsibilities, and not the starry-eyed teens anymore…those can be ‘nostalgia” dreams everybody has occasionally.
